title: The wand
starting_code: # Walk over, pick up the wand, and come back to the mark.
hints: First, move to the right to stand beside the flat stone.
Use the `pick_up` method to get the wand.
After you have the wand, use `move_left` and `move_down` to reach the mark.
intro: I have a spare wand I can lend you, but so that you practise a little, I left it on that stone. Walk over, pick it up, and come back to the mark by the path!
outro: You got it! Now that you have a wand, we can try casting some real magic.
learned: Now you know that things are objects too, and how to pick them up.
